source.author: lucan
source.text: Atque ingressurus steriles sic fatur arenas: O quibus una salus placuit mea castra secutis Indomita cervice mori, componite mentes Ad magnum virtutis opus summosque labores.
source.text_original: Atque ingressurus steriles sic fatur arenas: / O quibus una salus placuit mea castra secutis / Indomita cervice mori, componite mentes / Ad magnum virtutis opus summosque labores.
source.text_english: And as he was about to enter the barren sands, he spoke thus: O you who have chosen as your one salvation to follow my camp, to die with your neck unbent, steel your minds for the great task of valor and for the highest hardships.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: nate indignos aditure labores, dividimur; nec ad hos animum componere casus ante datum, sed bella tibi terrasque timebam.
reuse.text_original: 'nate indignos aditure labores, / dividimur; nec ad hos animum componere casus / ante datum, sed bella tibi terrasque timebam.
reuse.text_english: Son, who are to undertake unworthy labors, we are being separated; nor was it granted me beforehand to prepare my mind for these misfortunes, but I feared for you wars and lands.
